title: Answer: information states of the field, and thinned information structures

statements.text: On Shani and Keppler’s view a coherent system turns the disordered zero-point field into a phase-locked information state of higher information content, and every such state is associated with a conscious state. On Goff’s, local subjects inherit the aspects of cosmic experience that realize the high-level information structures neuroscience matches to experience.
